metadata.method: 3x3 Horn / bilinear UTM47N, heading converted to true north
metadata.point_method: Shapely representative_point inside original valid boundary
metadata.meaning: A synthetic ignition location with terrain sampled at that point; not an observed fire location or the slope of the whole forest
metadata.limitation: DSM includes canopy and buildings; slope fixed across each scenario, not a spatial raster propagation
